description: This file defines a specific exception class `GatewayPlaceholderReferenceUnknownFieldException`, which indicates that a request references a field that is unknown or does not exist in the referenced entity. The class contains methods for creating and parsing instances of this exception, including builders and static factory methods. It is part of the Eclipse Ditto project, related to handling exceptions in signal/command processing.

classes.name: GatewayPlaceholderReferenceUnknownFieldException
classes.description: An exception indicating that a request contains a placeholder referencing an unknown field on a referenced entity.

classes.name: GatewayPlaceholderReferenceUnknownFieldException.Builder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing instances of `GatewayPlaceholderReferenceUnknownFieldException` with a fluent API.

methods.name: fromUnknownFieldAndEntityId
methods.description: Creates a builder for an exception based on an unknown field and referenced entity ID.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs an exception instance by reading data from a JSON object.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with updated headers.
